This is some text inside of a div block. This is some text inside of a div block. פורסם: 12/28/2025 Are you a big-thinking, problem-solving coding genius with strong teamwork skills? We want you! About Us Arbox is the leading all-in-one solution for fitness, wellness, teaching, and course businesses. Our innovative platform is specifically designed to streamline operations, optimize efficiency, and empower business owners to achieve remarkable growth. Who We’re Looking For We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help shape our product, drive innovation, and scale our technology across multiple verticals- including fitness, wellness, beauty, clinics, and more. In this role, you’ll be a key contributor and technical leader within our development team. You’ll design and build new features end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and collaborate across teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for a diverse and growing customer base. ‍ What Your Day at Arbox Will Look Like ‍ Design, develop, modify, debug, and maintain both front-end and back-end features based on detailed functional, non-functional, and technical specifications. Take full ownership of features from concept to production—including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and monitoring. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver excellent user experiences across multiple business verticals in an agile environment. Lead and participate in code reviews, ensuring high-quality standards, clean architecture, and best practices across the team. Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for optimization, scalability, and system-wide enhancement. Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance, helping grow the team’s capabilities. Support project planning, sprint management, and workflow organization to ensure efficient execution. Participate in operational responsibilities, including troubleshooting production issues and maintaining system reliability. Contribute to long-term technical strategy, architecture, and decision-making. What You’ll Need for the Job A collaborative, positive personality with excellent communication and teamwork skills. 5+ years of experience in full-stack or web development with both front-end and back-end frameworks. Experience with MySQL (schema design, optimization). Experience with React – Huge advantage . Experience with PHP (Laravel Framework) – Huge advantage . Experience working with AWS Cloud services – Advantage . Background in a fast-paced tech environment—ideally a scaling startup with a SaaS product. Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and a proactive “can-do” approach. Ability to manage priorities, guide teammates, and contribute to leadership within the dev team. Passion for innovation, solving complex problems, and delivering impactful solutions. Location & Work Style Full-time role, hybrid - 4 days in the office and 1 day working from home. Based in the BSR Towers in Bnei Brak, Israel. ‍ Full Stack Developer / Jobs Full Stack Developer Updated on This is some text inside of a div block. This is some text inside of a div block.
